cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.title: Community Helper Discovery Basket
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.objective: Explore helper props and photos to build job vocabulary.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.description: Children examine hats, tools, and helper cards from a basket and talk about who uses them.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.materials:
Basket
Assorted helper props
Helper picture cards (printable)
Printable (draft): Community Helper Picture Cards
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.preparation:
Fill basket with safe props from many jobs
Include diverse helper images
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.setup: Circle or small-group basket at child height.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.steps:
1. Pull one item and wonder aloud who might use it
2. Invite children to try hats/props
3. Match a prop to a helper card if they choose
4. Share which helper they want to play today
5. Return props to basket
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.teacherLanguage: Who might use this tool? What job helps our community?
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.observationOpportunities: Names helpers; matches tool to role; handles props safely.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.safetyNotes: No sharp tools; supervise small props.
teacherTips: Include library, mail, sanitation, grocery — not only emergency jobs.

substitutions.use: classroom blocks, paper, or dramatic-play stand-ins

observationPrompts: Names helpers; matches tool to role; handles props safely.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.adaptations: Offer picture supports, a quieter station, or a peer partner as needed.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.extensions: Add a child leadership turn or an open-ended follow-up challenge.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.mixedAgeAdaptations: Younger preschoolers: fewer choices. Older preschoolers: add recording, labeling, or peer teaching.
cur-act-dae3ceb517ee1057.imageBriefSetup: Low basket with mixed helper hats/tools and picture cards.

cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.title: Community Places Map Talk
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.objective: Connect helpers to community places using a simple map/signs.
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.description: Children place helper cards on a map or near place signs (clinic, library, market, post office, build zone).
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.materials:
Map poster or floor map
Place signs (printable)
Helper cards
Printable (draft): Community Helper Picture Cards
Printable (draft): Helper Place Signs
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.preparation:
Post signs at child height
Prepare sticky dots/clips
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.setup: Map on floor/wall with signs nearby.
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.steps:
1. Name places on the map
2. Choose a helper card
3. Decide where that helper works
4. Place card/sign together
5. Tell one way the helper helps
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.teacherLanguage: Where does this helper work? How do they help?
cur-act-deff9908a05268dc.observationOpportunities: Links helper to place; uses place words.
teacherTips: Accept multiple right answers (nurses in clinics/hospitals/schools).

cur-act-988e83297cb9492c.description: Children take turns as patients, nurses, doctors, or caregivers using a play clinic.
cur-act-988e83297cb9492c.materials:
Play doctor kit
Bandages
Clipboards
Clinic sign
Stuffed animals optional
Printable (draft): Helper Place Signs

Stage clinic with waiting chairs
Review gentle touch rules

4. Explain how you are helping

cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.title: Helper Tools Exploration Table
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.objective: Investigate safe play tools and discuss which helpers might use them.
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.description: Children explore oversized play tools and helper cards at a table, sorting by interest and talking about jobs.
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.materials:
Safe play tools
Helper cards
Trays
Magnifiers optional
Printable (draft): Community Helper Picture Cards
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.preparation:
Set 4–5 tool trays
Add diverse helper cards
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.steps:
1. Choose a tool to investigate
2. Describe what it does
3. Guess which helpers might use it
4. Optional: place near a helper card
5. Try another tool
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.teacherLanguage: What job might need this tool?
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.observationOpportunities: Describes function; connects to helper; collaborates.
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.safetyNotes: Play tools only; no real hammers/sharp objects.
cur-act-30b83d919dab458c.cleanupTips: Return tools to silhouettes on shelf.
teacherTips: Accept creative answers (tape measure → builder or tailor).

cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.title: Sanitation Recycle Sort
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.objective: Sort clean recyclables/trash play items the way sanitation helpers keep communities clean.
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.description: Children sort large clean items into recycle/trash/compost play bins and talk about helpers who collect them.
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.materials:
3 bins with picture labels
Clean recyclable props
Gloves optional (play)
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.preparation:
Use only clean safe props
Label bins clearly
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.steps:
1. Name each bin
2. Pick an item and decide
3. Sort into bin
4. Count how many in a bin
5. Thank sanitation helpers in chant
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.teacherLanguage: Where should this go to help our community stay clean?
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.observationOpportunities: Sorts with reason; counts; uses helper language.
cur-act-f6f61c2531250ce6.safetyNotes: No glass/broken items; wash hands after.
teacherTips: Honor sanitation workers explicitly — often overlooked.
